title: Shiv Sena UBT ‘split’ buzz: Raut defends hurling abuses, alleges ₹50 crore lure offer to MPs — what happened so far
description: Sanjay Raut, who earlier rejected speculations that his party MPs being in touch with Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister and Shiv Sena leader Eknath Shinde, said on Tuesday, “If anyone wants to leave, they can do so by resigning…”
